tool_args.rationale: The prior authoring attempt failed because its prediction path referenced an undefined train_rows variable. This corrected implementation numerically fits the three identifiable node_C parameters on all six paid observations, using u_n=u_now/0.05 and the positive sqrt(u_n) branch supported by the acquired discriminating row. No further measurement is justified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its additional row supports the positive square-root branch, so another probe is unnecessary.
The horizon is short relative to the stated slow-ODE challenge and the observed signatures favor the static two-layer siphon; the ODE would add unnecessary parameters and cost.
The acquired open-branch row and the six varied input/gradient outcomes support a positive local square-root contribution rather than a negative linear leak.

considered_alternatives.option: node_Q cooperative Hill inhibition or node_R barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These require distinct functional dependence on input and/or sink; the stated pilot signatures and W3 bridge context favor the simpler node_C two-layer siphon.
